output:
```dockerfile
FROM node:20 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
FROM node:20-alpine
USER node
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev && npm cache clean --force
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```
Bina vs runtime terpisah, bukan-root, prod-deps sahaja, healthcheck. `.dockerignore` (node_modules/.git) wajib seiring.

instruction: How do I structure an Express project?
output:
```
src/
  app.js         # create + middleware, export app (no listen)
  server.js      # listen + signals (imports app)
  routes/users.js  # Router per resource
  middleware/auth.js rateLimit.js error.js
  lib/db.js      # pool/client singleton
  config.js      # validated env (zod/envalid)
test/users.test.js
```
`app.js` tanpa listen (supertest import terus), `server.js` nipis (isyarat sahaja), router per sumber, config disahkan semasa boot. Boleh uji tanpa port.
